format: C# ASP.NET Web Forms (code-behind for .aspx page)
description: This file contains the server-side logic for displaying and submitting answers for an online examination system, including database interactions for fetching and updating student answers and marks.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page ShowAns.aspx that manages displaying answers and handling form submissions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization, fetches student answers from database and populates form fields.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates the database with the student's answers, removes the student from the theory course queue, and redirects.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
